source: Constructed by this generator; no market quote was copied.
note: Normal volatility in basis points, strikes absolute. ATM levels and the sign of the skew are typical of the USD swaption grid, but every number is generated from vol(m) = atm * (1 + -0.03 m + 0.02 m^2) with m the strike offset in units of 100 bp. The shape is quadratic in moneyness, which SABR is not, so the residual in PRD-002 AC-3.2 measures the expansion's fit to a smile it did not produce. The 5y10y slice omits the -50 bp strike on purpose: that is the gap AC-3.1 fills.
